reason: The bounded startup implementation and its evidence are complete. The orchestrator must name and independently verify the resulting commit before changing this checklist to ready-for-audit or updating commitChecked.

boundary.startingEvent: A new D:1 game with OPTIONS=mention_decor has completed newgame and welcome(TRUE), leaving the welcome message pending while the hero stands on the traversed up staircase.
boundary.endingEvent: moveloop_preamble(FALSE) has run its initial pickup(1), the staircase description is visible at the first command-input boundary, and iflags.prev_decor is STAIRS without consuming a turn or moving the hero.
boundary.validInputs: New games with mention_decor, ordinary D:1 traversed up staircase, default verbose, short ASCII identity, no legacy/tutorial/splash screen, no starting floor object or engraving; autopickup either enabled or disabled. Primary case uses a quiet non-Friday, non-full/new-moon date; a full-moon plus Friday case verifies prior message ordering.
boundary.observables: Exact PRNG order and count, complete terminal cells and attributes, cursor positions, pending-message and More input boundaries, prev_decor from STONE to STAIRS, unchanged hero position/turn/inventory/floor state, status dirtiness, and arrival at first command input.
boundary.exclusions: Restore startup, nonverbose wording, starting objects or automatic collection, starting engravings, tutorial/legacy/accessibility prompts, endgame or Amulet stair names, non-stair terrain, all movement, check_here, object-pile rendering, and every describe_decor branch other than the initial traversed up staircase.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: Traced allmain.c newgame/welcome and moveloop_preamble(FALSE), pickup.c pickup(1) and describe_decor(), invent.c dfeature_at(), stairs.c stairs_description(), and options.c opt_mention_decor.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: Bounded terrain to STAIRS at D:1's traversed up staircase; checked mention_decor, verbose, autopickup, moon phase and Friday option/date families that can alter startup messages and waits.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: Followed welcome pline pending state; calendar messages; rnd(9000); set_wear(NULL); reset_justpicked(); pickup's no-object early arm; dfeature/stair naming; pline More sequencing; prev_decor assignment; rnd(30); and the first command capture.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Inspected js/jsmain.js startup order, js/moveloop_preamble.js omissions, js/options.js option state, js/pickup.js early refusal, js/invent.js dfeature_at, js/stairs.js naming, and js/tty_message.js pending-message behavior; searched all js/ and tests for mention_decor, prev_decor, moveloop_preamble and pickup(1).
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The fresh quiet and full-moon-plus-Friday matrix matched 5,177 PRNG calls and all 6 screens, attributes, cursors, and input boundaries. Movement, repeated decor, other terrain, objects, engravings, nonverbose output, exceptional hero state, restore, and endgame stairs remain outside this slice.

sourceReview: The complete selected path was retraced against allmain.c moveloop_preamble(FALSE), pickup.c reset_justpicked(), pickup(1), and describe_decor(), options.c opt_mention_decor, invent.c dfeature_at(), stairs.c stairs_description(), and u_init.c ini_inv_use_obj(). The trace covers calendar output, both PRNG calls, starting equipment equivalence, pickup memory, the empty-floor predicate, TTY waits, prev_decor ordering, and the command boundary. Every reachable excluded family has an atomic negative test or remains before the new-game call site.
